witness.branch: Road entry from curb into vehicle path.
witness.quote: leave a curb or other place of safety and walk or run into the path of a vehicle
witness.reason: Pedestrian entry onto the road can be constructed as departure from a curb into the control vehicle's path.
required_context: Construct a curb-based road-entry route and identify the separate control vehicle's position and motion relative to it.
Demonstrate entry into the vehicle's path separately from entry into the roadway.
Establish the vehicle's actual path and distinguish entry into it from entry into the roadway.
Identify pedestrian ego, curb geometry, qualifying control vehicle, driver and control status.
Identify pedestrian ego, qualifying vehicle and its driver and control status.
Keep suddenness and impossibility uninterpreted; declare any physical calculation assumptions.
Preserve introductory exceptions and unresolved operative provisions without assuming their applicability.
Retain predeparture, departure and encounter motion.
Retain synchronized predeparture and encounter trajectories, proximity and relative occupancy.
witness.subject_reason: The available pedestrian is the law's subject and performs the fixed road-entry task.
